artworks.title: Saint Christopher
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Aachen Madonna
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure carrying another figure on its back while wading through water. The drawing has a strong use of lines and bold outlines, giving it a woodcut print appearance. The central figure appears robust, holding a long staff for support as it steps through stylized flowing water, which is depicted using curved lines. The figure on its back is smaller and seated. Surrounding this scene are several trees with large leaves and intricate linework. The background appears dotted, providing texture, and the overall palette includes muted greens and browns.

artworks.title: Saint Christopher
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Aachen Madonna
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in green and ochre
artworks.description: The image shows a bearded man standing in a river with a child on his shoulders. The man is holding a staff and the child has a halo. Surrounding them are trees, and there is another figure on the riverbank. The background has a speckled design.

artworks.title: Saint Dorothy
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Aachen Madonna
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in red, green, and yellow
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with long hair and delicate facial features, holding a basket of flowers and a palm frond, wearing a red garment, and a halo. The background is decorated with floral patterns.

artworks.title: Saint Dorothy
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Aachen Madonna
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in red, green, and yellow
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures in a decorative, stylized format reminiscent of historical religious iconography. The central figure is larger, standing with a slight lean and gazing downwards. They have long, flowing golden hair, a halo with rays, and are dressed in a draped garment and cloak. In one hand, they hold a basket of fruit, and their other hand is extended downwards. The second, smaller figure to the lower left also has a halo and looks up at the larger figure. They wear a long robe and hold a flowering branch. The background has a dark border with floral designs and circular clusters. The top of the image is inscribed with the names "Sancta Dorothea," identifying the figures as Saint Dorothy.

artworks.title: Saint Erasmus
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in green, yellow, and red
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an anatomical scene. The image shows various figures gathered around a central figure on a table, who seems to be undergoing a medical or anatomical procedure. The figure on the table lies supine with a visible incision, and there is a cord-like element emerging from the body. Surrounding the table are figures in medieval attire, with head coverings and robes, observing the procedure. The background features intricate patterns and two arched window-like structures with green checker patterns. The scene is framed under an arch, providing a sense of depth and focus.

artworks.title: Saint George
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Aachen Madonna
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in red, green, and yellow
artworks.description: This is a painting of a knight on horseback slaying a dragon. The image shows a medieval knight in intricately dotted armor riding a similarly adorned horse, thrusting a lance into a dragon. The dragon is detailed with scales and is writhing under the horse's hooves. To the left, behind a leafy tree, is a figure adorned with a crown, observing. On the right, two faces peer from a tower, both also crowned. The use of color, including red, green, and yellow, adds vividness to the differentiated elements. The illustration combines elements of storytelling and myth, typical of medieval iconography. This is in the style of Albrecht Dürer, known for his detailed woodcuts and engravings from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Saint Gregory
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Aachen Madonna
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in green, yellow, and ochre
artworks.description: The image shows an individual in a richly patterned robe and ornate headpiece kneeling and facing right. The person has a serious expression and is looking up towards another figure emerging from a rectangular structure. This second figure has a halo, skeletal frame, raised hands, and a solemn face. To the left is a second person in modest attire. The scene is surrounded by detailed motifs, including pillars and a textured background.

artworks.title: Saint Jost
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Aachen Madonna
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in red, orange, and green
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body illustration of a figure standing. The person faces forward with a serene expression, featuring an elongated face with small, closed lips and downcast eyes, wavy shoulder-length hair, wearing a long, brown and red patterned robe and cloak, with a halo around the head. They hold a wooden staff and a book, with a rosary draped over the hand holding the book. The background has lush green floral designs with white and yellow flowers, framed within a rectangular border, and the name "SANT JACOB" inscribed at the top.

artworks.title: Saint Margaret
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Stoeger Passion
artworks.description: The image depicts an incomplete upper body view of a person with facial features showing almond-shaped eyes and a serene expression. The figure has curly hair and a halo-like adornment around the head. The individual wears intricately detailed clothing and holds a narrow object in one hand. The background features an elaborate floral pattern in dark tones.

artworks.title: Saint Sebastian
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in green, rose, and yellow
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures from head to mid-leg. The central figure on the left is leaning against a tree and appears to be tied to its trunk, with arrows piercing their body. This person has closed eyes and distinct facial features. The clothing of this individual isn't visible, indicating bare skin around the upper body and upper legs. To the right of this figure, there are three other individuals wearing robes and distinctive headwear. The person forefront on this side has a light-hued garment with a green hat, while the other figures wear robes with a headpiece and hold a rod or staff. The setting includes a ground covered with vegetation, predominantly small plants and leaves, surrounded by a decorative border.

artworks.title: Saint Sophia
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Aachen Madonna
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in red lake, green, and yellow
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures. One figure is a woman standing and holding a baby. The woman has long, golden hair and a serene expression. Both figures have halos around their heads. The woman is wearing a red garment. The baby is wrapped in cloth and nestled against her. In the background, there is a structure with a window showing another face with a halo. The ground is patterned green and the sky has turquoise accents. The image has a yellow and black border.

artworks.title: Saint Ursula as Protectress
artworks.artist: German 15th Century or Master of the Protective Saints of Cologne
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in light green, flesh, and rose
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in the center of an arch-like background. The individual wears a long gown and a crown, with flowing hair. One hand holds rods or wands, and the other holds an open book. A chain or necklace is worn around their neck. Flanking them are smaller figures that appear to be children. The background features arched windows with green glass and a floor with a pattern of black and green triangles. The color palette includes earth tones, green, and pink accents.

artworks.title: Saint Franciscus
artworks.description: The image shows a complex pattern of interwoven lines and shapes that create an abstract texture. The design resembles a worn tapestry or an eroded mural, with fading details and abstract shapes. The composition suggests layers of history in dark and earthy tones, reminiscent of ancient manuscripts or weathered artifacts.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child
artworks.description: The image shows a worn rectangular section of an aged, textured surface, possibly an old document. The majority of the surface is reddish-brown with black and grey smudges. Faint outlines of figures are visible. No specific details can be discerned. The surrounding area is lighter with handwritten text or numbers at the bottom.

artworks.title: Saint George
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an intricate, complex pattern or scene. The image features decorative elements and possibly a figure in the middle, surrounded by organic shapes resembling foliage or ornate patterns. The entire piece has a textured, aged appearance with a rustic color palette dominated by browns and ochres, indicating it might be from an older period or made using traditional methods. The central figure or object is faint but seems to take on a central role within this composition.

artworks.title: Christ Carrying the Cross
artworks.description: The image features a rectangular shape filled with interlocking lines and small scrawling patterns that create an abstract design. The central panel is vibrant reddish-brown, resembling a worn piece of tapestry or carved wood, on a lighter paper background with handwritten text at the top. The scene suggests an ancient document or a manuscript page adorned with abstract elements.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, a woman holding a child closely. Their faces are depicted in detail, with the woman's head slightly tilted towards the child. Both figures have halos, and the woman's hair is flowing. Their clothing is intricately patterned with fabric folds. The background features ornate details like arched windows and circular designs. The color palette is muted, emphasizing the detailed elements in the scene.

artworks.title: Saint John the Baptist
artworks.description: The image depicts a person seated with their full body visible. The person's face is not identifiable due to heavy texturing. The person's hair appears to be long. The clothing covers most of the body and could be a robe-like garment. The background is dark and speckled, possibly representing intricate details or decorative motifs. The artwork appears weathered and aged.

artworks.title: Saint Michael
artworks.artist: German 15th Century after Master of the Dutuit Mount of Olives
artworks.description: The image displays swirling and looping lines forming an intricate, textured pattern. The abstract artwork resembles a tapestry woven from Earth-toned fibers, with shades of brown, black, and orange. The interwoven lines create patterns that could be seen as resembling foliage or a rugged terrain. The complexity of the image draws connections to textures found in nature, such as tree bark or dried leaves, showcasing how abstract compositions can mimic the natural world.

artworks.title: Trinity
artworks.description: The image displays a dense arrangement of overlapping lines and shapes forming a rectangular block with uneven edges. The pattern is abstract, with dark and rusty hues creating a textured appearance. The irregular lines and patches suggest an organic quality, resembling tree bark or rocky landscape topography. The overall composition appears like a mosaic featuring dark and earthy tones.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child
artworks.description: The image shows a square composition filled with dark, nebulous shapes and lines. These lines and forms create an abstract pattern, evoking a sense of weathered texture. The overall appearance is abstract, with interwoven and overlapping elements, resembling chaotic brushstrokes or a densely tangled ground.

artworks.title: Saint Margaret
artworks.description: The image shows a weathered print of a figure in a seated position. The figure's face is not distinct, and they appear to wear a crown or halo. The person wears robes and holds an object. The background is dark with abstract patterns and the print is bordered with an orange-red frame on a beige or light brown surface.

artworks.title: Saint Catherine
artworks.description: The image shows a depiction of a figure, possibly a saint or religious icon, from the waist up. The figure has an upright posture with a tilted head and a raised arm. Facial features are unclear due to the aged condition of the image, but suggest a serene or focused expression. A halo-like structure surrounds the head. The clothing is detailed with flowing lines and patterns. The figure is within a decorative border with a red outer edge. The background is dark with flowing lines. The image appears old and worn, indicating historical or cultural significance.

artworks.title: Unknown Saint
artworks.description: The image shows a square area of a weathered piece of paper with a faded illustration of a figure seated in the center. The details of the person are indistinct due to the deterioration of the image, but there is a general outline of a human-like figure. The person's position seems to be sitting, and the facial features are not discernible. The figure appears to be cloaked or robed in a patterned garment with intricate designs that are obscured. The background contains indistinct motifs and patterns within a reddish-brown border. The surrounding paper displays signs of wear with an uneven texture and aged edges.
